positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer for AWS SageMaker's ML Frameworks team, developing and supporting multiple open source projects, including SageMaker's Python SDK and the ML Framework toolkits to improve the use of SageMaker by scientists and engineers alike. Support and develop internal and external build and deploy infrastructure utilizing the Cloud Developer Kit, Docker, CodeBuild, CodePipeline, and other build tools. Led initiatives to design and implement software packages and AWS SageMaker features that are used and will be used by AWS customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led the Display Ad Server's data infrastructure team to design and implement scalable, reliable logging services to support high velocity and volume ad traffic and decision logic events for large fleets of hosts to support operational and financial reporting for internal and external organizations. Led the team to design and develop log certification, workflow orchestration, and data lake population using serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda, Glue, EMR, and other internal tools to support querying and processing. Optimized storage strategies, governance, and lifecycle policies to support privacy and accessibility and reduce expenditures.

Led the Display Ad Server's compute infrastructure team to design automated topology management of compute. Helped advise and design migration and implementation from fixed, internal infrastructure to use of elastic or serverless AWS technologies.

Worked for Amazon's internal ML console to provide a no-setup experience for data scientists and machine learning engineers. Design and implemented the back-end worker architecture on AWS EC2 for increased security and scalability, and an on-demand compute experience. The project included a no-downtime migration from a static, capped fleet of internal hosts to the elastic, on-demand worker fleet. Designed and implemented the R kernel used by the ML console. Supported and improved the Python developer experience.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Authored data flow framework in Python, now used by internal teams, to execute and manage streaming and batch ETL processes utilizing internal and AWS systems, including Lambda, Kinesis, SNS, SQS, Redshift, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, S3, and HTTP services.

Contributed to internal Python community packages and modeling Python third-party packages in Amazon's internal build system. Initiated and contributed to internal initiatives to bring in Airflow and re:dash as viable packages available to all teams in Amazon's internal build and deployment systems.

Designed, developed, and tested Python packages to perform ETL for Kindle ad delivery and device event metrics using data flow framework. Designed and built Redshift data models in support of analytics for ad delivery and device event metrics. Updated real-time processing systems built in Java in support of ad delivery and ad publication ingestion. Updated ETL status management system built in Go. 

Supported AWS Elastic MapReduce jobs using Pig, Hive, and Python. Supported internal Django-powered portal supported by visualizations in d3.js. Supported design of RDS PostgreSQL instances for real-time delivery system. Performed data analysis using R, SQL, Python, Hive, and Pig. Supported operations of real-time ad filtering and delivery service, Django portal, and data processing pipelines in regular on-call rotation. Tuned MySQL RDS instances and performed MySQL query profiling and analysis.

Investigated use of Kinesis and Lambda to service real-time data processing needs of Kindle Ad Products team.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Authored ETL pipelines using Python, hive, and SQL on Facebook's Dataswarm ETL framework. End-to-end design and development of Hive, Oracle, and Vertica data models, associated ETL pipelines, and Tableau dashboards to support measurement and analysis of youth engagement for the Instagram app. Design and development of data models, ETL pipelines, and Tableau dashboard for visibility of Instagram's "sentry" application, responsible for content quality and user security.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Authored AWS Elastic MapReduce jobs using Pig, Hive, and Python in support of ad delivery and device event metrics. Developed custom Pig UDFs for specific use-case data gathering. Implemented AWS Elastic Data Pipelines processing data from multiple sources supported by integration and unit testing.

Surfaced ad and device event metrics and developed features on internally facing Django-powered portal supported by visualizations in d3.js. Developed data models and ETL jobs from S3 and Oracle into portal. Designed services to support ad metadata delivery and database loader processes.

Performed data analysis using R, SQL, Python, Hive, and Pig. Supported operations of real-time ad filtering and delivery service, Django portal, and data processing pipelines in regular on-call rotation. Tuned MySQL RDS instances and performed MySQL query profiling and analysis. Investigated use of AWS Redshift in support of core data architecture needs. 

Executed hardware capacity planning and purchasing across team's service profile for 2014. Mentored summer intern in developing a data investigation and visualization framework to extend portal functionality. Contributed to internal Django, Python, Apache Pig and Hive community packages.

positions.title: Data Architect and Database Administrator
positions.description:
Designed and developed MultiCare's Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and Operational Data Store (ODS). Developed data marts to support customers and managed supporting ETL packages. Defined technology strategy for analytics in data group. Presented outcomes and best-practice strategies to senior leadership and steering committees. Developed and co-taught SQL courseware at MultiCare.

Developed geo-coding procedure for patient addresses using PostGIS. Analyzed distribution of cohorts of diabetes patients versus obesity by geographic region. Developed data visualizations for Sepsis initiative. Implemented predictive models for patient wait times at Urgent Care Clinics and risk of readmission for heart failure patients. Applied statistical analysis in R for payor information and patient satisfaction data.

Directed DBA security overhaul, upgrades and installs of Microsoft SQL Server, upgrade of SSIS packages. Managed 60 production Microsoft SQL Server database servers hosting over 450 production user databases. Architected, implemented, and managed SQL Server 2008 R2 and 2005 active-active clusters, and stand-by replication nodes for disaster recovery. 

Designed centralized maintenance plans across SQL Servers. Designed and implemented applications and SSIS packages for integration of Active Directory, Human Resources, Security, and SharePoint systems. Developed multiple departmental windows services, web applications, and scripts. Diagnosed performance issues at the server and database level using SQL Profiler and Performance Monitor.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Computer Science and Systems
positions.description:
PHP, javascript, and MySQL development for data dashboard built on a LAMP stack for the Office of the Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI) in Washington. Authored data visualizations using d3.js. Managed data loads and extracts.

Ruby on Rails development for dietary data recording system (DDRS) in partnership with the UWEE department. Administered multiple Linux servers with various stacks of MySQL/PostgreSQL, Apache/Nginx, Rails/Drupal.

positions.title: Instructional Facilitator - Computer Science and Systems
positions.description: Lead weekly and twice-weekly two- and three-credit workshop recitations for Computer Science and Systems CSE 142, CSE 321, and CSE 342 promoting group collaboration and challenging student thinking. Authored worksheets and new questions for shared pool. Held formal discussions with other facilitators regarding educational improvements to format and content.

positions.title: Software Developer - Contractor
positions.description:
Developed Nippon Life Proposal Generation System version 1.11 through 1.14 update. Involved in developing a specification with client and creating a
project plan. 

Designed changes to current ASP/Visual Basic/MS SQL Server system, implemented those changes, created and executed test plans, and installed update package on test server for UAT.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
On development team of CareGuide QI 4.0, an engine for evidence-based clinical guidelines. Co-developer of rating system engines for Blue Cross Blue Shield, RI, Nippon Life, NY, and Central Benefits, OH. 

Provided on-site support of developed software as well as Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle databases. Worked with customers to understand specifications and rating systems in order to code and develop rating engines. Helped develop XLogic, a technology to automate rating and underwriting functions.

positions.title: Professor of Mathematics
positions.description:
Instructor for classes from Pre-Algebra through Calculus III. Promoted an open, collaborative learning environment. Crafted lectures designed to strengthen prior knowledge and inspire curiosity in upcoming material. Designed course curricula for the Mathematics program. 

Designed labs and homework assignments related to course material to build confidence, promote critical thinking, and offer challenges to grow. Held regular office hours. Administered and graded labs, homework, quizzes and tests.

projects.title: ET Games Company
projects.description: After crafting board games for many years, a buddy of mine and I finally decided to create a company to bring some of our creations to the public. We like inventing games that are exciting to us, games that are fun for our friends and family to play, and games that make for memorable play time and again.
